correctness.rationale: For B_3(|K_{2,2,2}|), the weight-three reduced Swiatkowski complex has signed free chain ranks (364,1404,1620,540), verified differential-square-zero, and integer echelon boundary ranks (363,1033,540). Inspected oct3_sym.py: integer_image_basis performs complete integer column reductions, normalizing only pivots +/-1; triangular unit minors imply primitive boundary images, not merely rational full ranks. Thus H_0=Z, H_1=Z^8, H_2=Z^47, no torsion. The complete 48-element signed-permutation actions are chain maps; image_trace and class characters recover the ten-class table and Specht-bipartition multiplicities. A separate sufficient-subdivision Abrams cubical model has cell counts (816,2880,3192,1088), field ranks (815,2057,1088) and Lefschetz cross-checks. A finite-field check alone would not prove integral primitivity.
residual_risks: The exact large integer reductions and entire 48-element action were inspected as reproducible source code, not independently rerun to completion in this audit; implementation-error risk remains. Integral character lattice and homotopy type not determined.
